decision: Do not change native promotion thresholds again. The independently refitted mixed logistic is already a verified optional public-run tool and winner over the installed gas observer in three development streams, while the old observer protects two external chips and some rare classes. Before changing the recommended entry, swap or add only that tool's vote, compare delivery predictions. Keep the official native voter intact in the add arm. Strong cheapest controls are the standalone mixed and existing observer; both preinstalled and available under same feedback cap. Fixed adapters derived from existing mature confusion calibration, not independent novelty.
data: 13 already frozen feedback draws; public, UCI batches 3-10, year-long 5-class, and SGP40 B/C. Score paired prior delivered logistic and original votes/feedback predictions from their SHA-identified chronological receipts, using exactly same completed source fits and feedback as originals. No new training or device claim. Verify current recommended public seed-17 service rows against team entry and direct refit against actual optional mixed integrated entry. If common scores pass across sites, reproduce the selected recipe live before adopting.
arms: Original mature observer and standalone fixed mixed, Add: original five prediction streams plus mixed as a sixth observer (same existing uniform prior/counts and tie behavior). Replace current vote only by mixed, retain the other four votes. Fixed mixed+one observer output probability not introduced. Autonomous: begin with original observer, on each prior batch use the before-label predictions of original observer, standalone mixed and Add; cumulative per-class confusion Macro-F1, switch only if gain >=.01, ties keep. Include informed-once waiting for the first real comparison with differing returned predictions then freeze the winner. No new network or labels. Each site uses its original bank even when number of original tools differs. Keep protection metrics per class, no operator branch by site.
decision_rule: Candidate must gain .01 over current recommendation on public and late and on both must have worst-category mean recall within .02 of current. For replacing a strong component or claiming autonomous value additionally compare to strongest of old observer, standalone refit, fixed Add and Replace on same sites (for fixed candidate compare to old observer and standalone refit); no score loss >.01 or worst recall drop >.02 versus existing observer on year, SGP40 B/C. If none survives, identify which fixed existing option can replace the default under these requirements and if none does keep default. An outcome on known data alone is not independent deployment verification.
